lines.en: Good morning! What can I get you?

lines.es: Hola, buenos días. Una barra de pan, por favor.
lines.en: Hi, good morning. A baguette, please.
Here you are. Anything else?

lines.es: No, gracias. ¡Qué bien huele el pan!
lines.en: No, thanks. The bread smells so good!

lines.es: Es pan del día. ¿Eres nueva en el barrio?
lines.en: It's fresh today. Are you new in the neighbourhood?

lines.es: Sí, acabo de mudarme a Madrid.
lines.en: Yes, I've just moved to Madrid.
Welcome! And do you like the neighbourhood?

lines.es: Sí, mucho. Lo conozco poco a poco.
lines.en: Yes, a lot. I'm getting to know it little by little.
That's eighty cents.
Here you are. Are you open every day?

lines.es: Sí, de lunes a sábado, desde las ocho.
lines.en: Yes, Monday to Saturday, from eight.
Perfect. See you tomorrow, then.
See you tomorrow!
Hi, are you new here?
Yes, hi. My name is Elena.
Nice to meet you, Elena. I'm Javier.

lines.es: Encantada. Acabo de mudarme a Madrid. Vivo cerca de aquí.
lines.en: Nice to meet you. I've just moved to Madrid. I live near here.
Welcome! Would you like a glass of water?

lines.es: Sí, gracias. Hoy estoy muy concentrada.
lines.en: Yes, thanks. I'm very focused today.

lines.es: ¿Trabajas con el ordenador todo el día?
lines.en: Do you work on the computer all day?
Yes, almost all day.

lines.es: Pues a las cuatro voy al parque. ¿Vienes?
lines.en: Well, at four I'm going to the park. Are you coming?
OK! I need to rest a bit.

lines.es: Hay un banco de madera muy tranquilo.
lines.en: There's a very quiet wooden bench.

lines.es: Perfecto. Nos vemos a las cuatro.
lines.en: Perfect. See you at four.
Good morning. What can I get you?

lines.es: Buenos días. Quiero tomates, por favor.
lines.en: Good morning. I'd like some tomatoes, please.
How many would you like?
Half a kilo.
Very good. Anything else?

lines.es: Sí, un pepino y un pimiento rojo.
lines.en: Yes, a cucumber and a red pepper.
Are you going to make a salad?

lines.es: Sí, una ensalada simple. Voy a cocinar en casa.
lines.en: Yes, a simple salad. I'm going to cook at home.

lines.es: ¡Qué rica! Son tres euros con veinte.
lines.en: Yummy! That's three euros twenty.
Can I pay by card?
Of course. Do you have a bag?

lines.es: Sí, tengo mi bolsa de tela.
lines.en: Yes, I have my cloth bag.
Great! Until next time.
Thanks, see you!

lines.es: Hola, buenas tardes. ¿Qué vas a tomar?
lines.en: Hi, good afternoon. What are you having?

lines.es: Hola. Un café con leche, por favor.
lines.en: Hi. A white coffee, please.
To have here or to take away?

lines.es: Para tomar aquí. Es la primera vez que vengo.
lines.en: To have here. It's my first time here.
Welcome! Sit wherever you like.

lines.es: Gracias. ¿Puedo sentarme junto a la ventana?
lines.en: Thanks. Can I sit by the window?
Of course… Here's your coffee.

lines.es: Gracias. Me siento a gusto aquí.
lines.en: Thanks. I feel comfortable here.
What are you reading?

lines.es: Un libro en español. Leo un poco cada día.
lines.en: A book in Spanish. I read a little every day.
How nice! Would you like anything else?
No, thanks. How much is it?
One euro eighty.
Here you are. See you!

narr.c2: Conversación dos. En el espacio compartido.
